summary: Finite MVP campaign closed: four admitted TT-CPD isomers have separately qualified provisional numerical models. Physical accuracy and parameter equivalence remain insufficient; no jobs active.

completed.label: Four external provisional NAMD models
completed.detail: cis-syn-I, cis-anti-I, trans-syn-I and trans-syn-II passed separate canonical two-start, two-seed numerical admission and short timestep diagnostics. Internal six-T engineering scope only; production unchanged.

remaining.label: Physical validation remains insufficient
remaining.detail: Experimental accuracy, equilibrium populations and practical equivalence are not established. No calibrated parameter-uncertainty family was tested. No automatic refinement or simulation extension; melting is user-owned.

remaining.label: Unqualified contexts and ordered isomers
remaining.detail: Terminal and mixed-isomer systems remain unqualified. Trans-anti I/II require resolved attachment-order evidence; cis-anti-II provenance remains unresolved.

history.label: Earlier anti campaign · historical model only
history.detail: Six 10 ns runs and a research restart package were completed. The three archived anti endpoints fail the corrected stereochemical identity; these results do not validate corrected cis-anti-I.

history.label: Corrected CPD core, archived DNA-context runs · chemistry hold
history.detail: Two welded/control10ns pairs completed engineering audits. Later canonical sugar-reference checks failed at the weld sites. Raw outputs and failed preflights retained; execution completion is not chemical qualification.

historicalWarning: Historical anti model evidence predating the stereochemistry correction. These checks do not qualify corrected cis-anti-I.
